The five existing cards on this chapter (krasner 33747-33811, lowering-the-level 35182-35367, pseudo-coherent 16062-16142, lift-stably-free 100-111, isomorphic-finite-projective-lifts 158-171) are far from these lines and state unrelated results.

The nearest same-chapter public item in the derived-category direction is public 362 (more-algebra.tex lines 4294-4367, finite-stage descent of flatness along a filtered colimit): it also converts a filtered colimit into a finite stage, but it concerns flatness of a module and its Tor amplitude, whereas this lemma enlarges a pair of subcomplexes of a fixed map of complexes and proves a cardinality bound on the result; neither the objects nor the conclusion coincide. Public 1344 (injectives.tex lines 1806-1887, functorial K-injective resolution) and public 419 (more-algebra.tex lines 32776-32866, Galois action on primes) share only the general derived-category setting.

The nearest public item by subject matter outside this chapter is 145940 (arXiv 2308.11353v2, source0.tex lines 373-378, "Filtered complexes and cohomologically equivalent subcomplexes", claim prop:Invariance): it works with filtered complexes and transversals in a different framework of a different paper, and asserts invariance properties for cotransversals rather than the existence of an enlargement of two given subcomplexes with a cardinal bound, so it is not the same proposition. Public 655 (sites-cohomology.tex lines 2629-2785) and the several filtered-colimit items of other chapters concern commutation of cohomology with filtered colimits as statements in their own right, not the enlargement construction proved here.

reference/retired-claims.json contains no entry mentioning enlarge or this label; PREPARATION_WORKLIST.jsonl contains no row whose claim_key, title or task path names lemma-enlarge; no task card anywhere under focused-seeds mentions the label or claims these coordinates; and the pool card of this chapter lists the candidate lemma-enlarge with ext_refs = 0, so the card introduces no navigation stub and no citation.
